title: apps/dashboard: v1beta1 is a thin wrapper; generated files are pruned by Makefile
answers: Why does v1beta1 look incomplete/missing generated files?
Can I hand-edit zz_generated.*.go or *_gen.go in apps/dashboard?
body:
v1beta1 is not a fully independent generated version — apps/dashboard/pkg/apis/dashboard/v1beta1/register.go:1-2 states it has "identical schemas... eliminates code duplication." apps/dashboard/Makefile:46-52 deletes generated v1beta1 object/codec/schema files after `make generate` runs (post-generate-cleanup step), and sed-strips generated DeepCopy for v0alpha1/v1beta1. So v1beta1 looking incomplete after codegen is expected, not a bug.
Do not hand-edit zz_generated.*.go, *_gen.go (codec/object/schema/spec/status), or CUE files — they carry "DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY" headers. Regenerate via `make generate` (run inside apps/dashboard/) or `make gen-apps app=dashboard` from repo root. apps/dashboard/tshack/*.ts holds hand-written TypeScript shims the Makefile copies over the SDK's incorrect auto-generated TS for specific versions — this is an intentional override, not stray code.
applies: Applies when generating or diffing apps/dashboard code; running the raw SDK generate step alone (without the Makefile's post-processing) will show spurious diffs against v1beta1 and DeepCopy files.
